title: Body Image and Self-Esteem
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind body image and self esteem and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply body image and self esteem in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using body image and self esteem to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what body image and self esteem means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying body image and self esteem in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how body image and self esteem works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use body image and self esteem in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to body image and self esteem. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
